```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-exaverif-ibex
#| fig-cap: "Verification time: standard evaluate vs structural enumeration across four fixture sizes. At CVA6 R4 2M scale, structural enumeration achieves 766x speedup."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": "sans-serif", "font.size": 9, "figure.dpi": 150})

fixtures = ["Small\n27 combos", "Medium\n32K combos", "Ibex\n524K combos", "CVA6 R4\n2M combos"]
evaluate_times = [3.26, 6580, 3.66e6, 1.23e6]
struct_times = [2.73, 3106, 46100, 1600]
speedups = [e / s for e, s in zip(evaluate_times, struct_times)]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [2, 1]})

x = np.arange(len(fixtures))
w = 0.3
ax1.bar(x - w/2, evaluate_times, w, label='evaluate (standard)',
        color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax1.bar(x + w/2, struct_times, w, label='struct_enum (synTagma)',
        color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2, hatch='///')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(fixtures, fontsize=7.5)
ax1.set_ylabel('Time (us, log scale)')
ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, (e, s, sp) in enumerate(zip(evaluate_times, struct_times, speedups)):
    mid = (e * s) ** 0.5
    label = f'{sp:.0f}x' if sp > 1 else f'{sp:.1f}x'
    ax1.annotate(label, xy=(i, mid), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
ax1.set_title('Verification Time by Approach', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

ax2.barh(fixtures, speedups, height=0.4, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
for i, sp in enumerate(speedups):
    label = f'{sp:.0f}x' if sp > 10 else f'{sp:.1f}x'
    ax2.text(sp + 5, i, label, va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Speedup factor')
ax2.set_title('synTagma Speedup', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlim(0, max(speedups) * 1.3)
ax2.tick_params(labelsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
